facts.summary: Strategic pivot to mitochondrial disease with 45% workforce cut, other programs deprioritized · clinical stage · CY6463 in MELAS · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The Company's workforce is being tailored to the mitochondrial disease-focused strategy, leading to a reduction of approximately 45%, to 16 full-time employees.
evidence.safety: the CY6463 safety profile has been favorable across all clinical studies to date
evidence.program_discontinued: Cyclerion will focus future development of CY6463 on genetic mitochondrial diseases, concentrating first on development in MELAS
